verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.pt: Aleluia! Cantai ao SENHOR um cântico novo; haja louvor a ele na congregação dos santos.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. Make a new song to the Lord, let his praise be in the meeting of his saints.

verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.pt: Alegre-se Israel em seu Criador; os filhos de Sião se encham de alegria em seu Rei.
verses.en_web: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.en_bbe: Let Israel have joy in his maker; let the children of Zion be glad in their King.

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.pt: Louvem seu nome com danças; cantai louvores a ele com tamborim e harpa.
verses.en_web: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
verses.en_bbe: Let them give praise to his name in the dance: let them make melody to him with instruments of brass and corded instruments of music.

verses.en: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.pt: Porque o SENHOR se agrada de seu povo; ele ornará os mansos com salvação.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has pleasure in his people: he gives the poor in spirit a crown of salvation.

verses.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.pt: Saltem de prazer seus santos pela glória; fiquem contentes sobre suas camas.
verses.en_web: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.en_bbe: Let the saints have joy and glory: let them give cries of joy on their beds.

verses.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.pt: Exaltações a Deus estarão em suas gargantas; e espada afiada estará em sua mão,
verses.en_web: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.en_bbe: Let the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hands;

verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.pt: Para se vingarem das nações, e repreenderem aos povos.
verses.en_web: To execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
verses.en_bbe: To give the nations the reward of their sins, and the peoples their punishment;

verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.pt: Para prenderem a seus reis com correntes, e seus nobres com grilhões de ferro;
verses.en_web: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.en_bbe: To put their kings in chains, and their rulers in bands of iron;

verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Para executarem sobre eles a sentença escrita; esta será a glória de todos os seus santos. Aleluia!
verses.en_web: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: To give them the punishment which is in the holy writings: this honour is given to all his saints. Praise be to the Lord.
